messages.subject: Relationship between relative abundance and density
parts:
Hello,
I was hoping someone may be able to direct me to references that describe how relative abundance, described in Royle & Nichols 2003, relates to density? From the reading I have done it appears to me that this relationship is not very clear. I appreciate that relative abundance and density are two very different methods of quantifying populations. 
Thanks in advance for helping me to get my head around this,
Pat
